Redmund

Redmund: Redmund is more of a clan than a family line. Redmund families are mostly traveling nomads who all share the same surname. On occasion, they will settle in nearby towns to focus on a given craft. They often are artists or sculptors, and can easily be found along trade routes, exchanging their crafts for food and other necessities.
雷德蒙德： 与其说「雷德蒙德」是一个家族世系，不如说它是一个氏族。雷德蒙德各家大多是漂泊的游民，共用同一个姓氏。他们偶尔也会在附近的城镇定居，专攻某门手艺。他们多为艺人或雕刻师，在商路上常能见到他们，以手艺换取食物和其他必需品。
res#59728/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Redmund
They are well liked, as families go, and there are few who do not know a Redmund personally. Once married, if the spouse is from another family, they give up the Redmund name and settle down.
在诸家族之中，他们颇受欢迎，几乎人人都认识至少一位雷德蒙德。婚后若配偶来自别的家族，他们便会放弃雷德蒙德之名，安定下来。
res#59851/whatIHaveToSay[0]
Ley

Ley: There has only been one Ley in all of Emerisk: Atticus Ley. I have chosen to include him because the surrounding events are notable. In what some would call an era of reason and stability, Emerisk had a madman. He claimed to be a wizard, but failed to produce any evidence of such claims. He was frequently found raving in the graveyard, up until his death.
莱伊： 整个埃梅里斯克只出过一个莱伊：Atticus·莱伊。我之所以把他收录进来，是因为围绕着他的事件颇为值得注意。在那个被一些人称为理性与稳定时代的时期，埃梅里斯克出了个疯子。他自称巫师，却拿不出任何证据。直到死去之前，人们常能看到他在墓地胡言乱语。
res#59851/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Ley

He claimed to be searching for his lost magic, which he had been tricked into sealing away in a tomb. No one is quite sure where he came from, but he continued his ravings up until his death. According to him, the magic could only be found by saying his name at the right location, written upon his gravestone. The graveyard is not very large, and one would think that he surely would have found the location were such a thing true. Interestingly, the name Atticus is itself a surname in the land of Ameyria, though it is pronounced Addicus.
他自称在寻找自己遗失的魔法，那魔法是被人设计封印在一座墓穴中的。没人说得清他来自何方，但他一直到死都在胡言乱语。据他说，只有在正确的地点、念出刻在他墓碑上的名字，才能找到那魔法。墓地并不大，若真有此事，照理说他早该找到那个地点了。有趣的是，Atticus 这个名字本身是阿梅利亚之地的一个姓氏，只是读作 Addicus。

Gyffard

Gyffard: Gyffard is a respected and hardworking line, tracing back hundreds of cycles, or more. Mostly farmers, they are well known for their work ethic and skill in food production. Records suggest a schoolhouse may also have been opened to train more farmers during a time of rapid expansion nearly a century ago.
吉法德： 吉法德是受人敬重、勤恳劳作的一脉，可追溯数百轮乃至更久之前。他们多为农夫，以敬业与粮食生产的本领闻名。有记录显示，在近百年前那段快速扩张的时期，他们还开办过一所学堂，以培养更多的农人。
res#60197/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Gyffard

Lately, there has been vocal criticism from patriarchs within the family over nobles and their abuse of lower classes. This criticism increased when military service in the family became more common, and soldiers serving under noble officers saw abuses firsthand.
近来，族中长辈对贵族欺凌下层阶级的抨击之声渐起。随着族中从军者增多、在贵族军官麾下服役的士兵亲眼目睹种种劣行，这种批评愈发强烈。
res#60288/whatIHaveToSay[0]
Ingram

Ingram: The Ingram family moved to Emerisk only within my lifetime, and I had not heard the name before. They began their life in this town in poverty, but they did not remain so. Josef Ingram always knew how to speak to people, and quickly grew as a respected and beloved member of the town; indeed he was a friend of mine.
英格拉姆： 英格拉姆家族是在我这一代才搬来埃梅里斯克的，此前我从未听过这个姓氏。他们初到此镇时一贫如洗，却没有一直如此。约瑟夫·英格拉姆一向善于与人交谈，很快便成为镇中受人敬爱的一员，事实上，他曾是我的朋友。
res#60288/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Ingram

Their wealth grew in social capital first, then monetarily, as they skillfully navigated the line between peasant and noble. I have rarely seen such skill with people, and their children are destined to be leaders as well.
他们的财富先是积累于人望，继而积累于金钱，他们精巧地游走于平民与贵族之间。我很少见过这般与人打交道的本领，他们的子女也注定会成为领袖。

Start
Common Surnames of Emerisk, Second Edition Forward note: I shall detail my knowledge of the family histories and personalities that persist in Emerisk, from ancient times until today.
《埃梅里斯克常见姓氏》 第二版 前言： 我将记述我所知的、埃梅里斯克从古至今绵延不衰的家族历史与风骨。
res#60440/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Start

It should be noted that these summaries by no means encompass all individuals, but rather family trends. If any take offense, I will take this into consideration and make amendments where needed, but I seek truth not fiction. None of the portrayals shall demean or impinge on the honor or history of that family. Gossip shall remain in the streets. Let us begin.
须知这些概述绝非涵盖每一个个体，而只记述家族的整体风貌。若有冒犯之处，我会纳入考量、酌情修订；但我要的是真相，而非传闻。任何记述都不会贬损或侵害那些家族的荣誉与历史。闲言碎语，就留在街头吧。我们开始。

Meyard

Meyard: Meyards are primarily herdsmen and shepherds who have been on Springhold since it was first discovered. They were likely part of the maiden voyages that founded the Isle. They are said to carry many secrets, both of family intrigue and food recipes.
梅亚德： 梅亚德人主要是牧人与羊倌，自斯普林霍尔德被发现之初便定居于此。他们很可能参与了开拓此岛的处女航。据说他们守着许多秘密，家族的恩怨内情，还有食膳配方。
res#60571/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Meyard
They often appear mild and unassuming but can be quite eccentric. I myself am a Meyard, and I can indeed confirm these things.
他们往往看似温和低调，实则相当古怪。我本人就是梅亚德，这两点我可以作证。
res#60638/whatIHaveToSay[0]
Wylde

Wylde: The Wylde family lineage is an uncertain one. It bears some resemblance to another family name, Weyld, but I will need more research to establish this for certain. In either case, Wyldes tend to be healers, herbalists, woodsmen and so on.
怀尔德： 怀尔德家族的血统来历并不明确。它与另一个姓氏「韦尔德」有些相似，但需要更多考证才能定论。无论如何，怀尔德人多是医者、草药师、樵夫之类。
res#60638/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Wylde

They have a strong connection to nature and often make their homes on the outskirts of towns and villages. They are notably trustworthy, and some say dangerous. Little else is known since they keep to themselves and pass their own history down within the family. If I can find any willing to speak I will amend this entry.
他们与自然有着深厚的联系，往往把家安在城镇村庄的边缘。他们出了名地可靠，也有人说，危险。除此之外所知甚少，因为他们深居简出，家族历史只在族内口耳相传。若能找到愿意开口的人，我会补订此篇。
res#60639/whatIHaveToSay[0]
Renault

Renault: There is much to be said about the Renault family. In truth, I should write a book for this alone, but I will keep my observations to a minimum. The Renault family was not always held in such esteem as it is now. It rose to prominence in the height of war with the dark lord.
雷诺： 关于雷诺家族，可说的实在太多。说实话，光是为它写一本书都不为过，但我只将观察压到最简。雷诺家族并非向来都享有今日这般的声望，它是在与黑暗领主的战争最激烈之时崛起的。
res#60639/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Renault

A Renault of unknown name, both a skilled warrior and leader, helped preserve the isle of Springhold against the armies of the dark lord, though. Despite a great deal of honor left in the family name, it is less represented in modern times, though the family still enjoys the benefits of an honorable lineage.


It has been requested changes be made to this section. I have done so, as requested. The changes are thus: Request denied.

一位姓名不详的雷诺（既是技艺精湛的战士，也是统率之才）曾助斯普林霍尔德岛抵御黑暗领主的军队。虽然家族之名仍余诸多荣耀，但如今声望已不如前，好在仍享着光荣血脉带来的种种荫庇。


有人请求修订本节。我照办了。修订内容如下：请求驳回。

Warde

Warde: Wardes were once considered a noble family, but the history about what happened has been lost. There have been some that sought to regain this prowess, but most are content to continue as is. Noble families in Emerisk are a touchy subject, and some might consider it better to not be considered as such.
沃德： 沃德家曾被视为贵族，但中间发生了什么都已湮没无闻。有人试图重振门楣，但大多安于现状。在埃梅里斯克，贵族之家是个敏感话题，有些人反倒觉得，不被当作贵族或许更好。
res#60797/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Warde

Wardes did play an important role in the fight against the dark lord, and were granted honor by many kings and queens. This may be where tales of nobility originated, but how such honors were solidified into family standing is unknown.
沃德家确实在与黑暗领主的斗争中扮演过重要角色，受诸多国王与女王嘉奖。贵族的传闻或许正源出于此，但这些荣誉如何固化为家族地位，已无人知晓。

Hayfest/Cole

Hayfest: Hayfests have been found on the Isle of Springhold since record keeping began. The family has a strong tradition of food preparation, especially meats, and descendants rarely stray from this profession. Exports of salted and dried meats from Springhold were a common subject of trade between Springhold and other nations, and such supplies were considered essential rations for soldiers in times of war.
海菲斯特： 自有记载以来，海菲斯特家便生活在斯普林霍尔德岛上。这个家族有着深厚的食物加工传统，尤其擅长处理肉类，后代少有离开此业者。斯普林霍尔德的腌肉与干肉出口，是当地与他国贸易的常见内容，战时更被视为士兵必不可少的口粮。
res#60934/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Hayfest/Cole

Cole: Coles of the modern era are mostly stone cutters and smiths, but the family originally came to Emerisk as fishermen. They still maintain a strong presence in villages along the coast of Springhold, where fishing is more accessible. Tool work, as seen in Emerisk, was likely introduced after a great wave hit the eastern coast in 2698, sweeping away many of the coastal settlements.
科尔： 当代的科尔家多以石匠与铁匠为业，但这个家族最初是以渔人身份来到埃梅里斯克的。他们在斯普林霍尔德沿岸的村庄依旧人丁兴旺，那里更便于捕鱼。而埃梅里斯克这一支的器具手艺，多半是在 2698 年巨浪席卷东海岸、冲毁许多沿海聚落之后才传入的。
res#60936/whatIHaveToSay[0]
Vawdrey

Vawdrey: Vawdreys are a talented family of tailors, and have been since Emerisk's founding. It is extremely rare for a child to forgo threadwork, and those that do often change their family name afterwards to fit their new profession.
沃德雷： 沃德雷家是天赋出众的裁缝世家，自埃梅里斯克建城起便是如此。族中子弟极少放下针线；若有另择他业者，往往会在事后改换姓氏，以配合新的行当。
res#60936/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Vawdrey

Vawdrey means fine clothing as much as it does family, and it is not difficult to see why the purity of their name would be so important to them. Many nobles in the area will not try any new clothing if it has not been made by the Vawdreys.
「沃德雷」既是一个家族，也意味着上等衣装。不难想见，他们为何如此看重这个名字的纯粹。这一带的许多贵族，若非沃德雷之家所制，便不肯试穿新衣。
res#60968/whatIHaveToSay[0]
Halle

Halle: The Halle family hearkens from the border regions of Amyeria, some 700 cycles ago. It is currently one of the most common names in all of Solmaria. Due to its widespread nature, it is difficult to sum up a history of the family name, though locally there has been higher than usual involvement in the humanities from this family.
哈勒： 哈勒家源于约七百轮前阿梅利亚的边陲之地，如今已是索尔玛利亚全境最常见的姓氏之一。因为枝繁叶茂，家族史很难一言蔽之；不过就本地而言，这个家族投身人文学科者多得出奇。
res#60968/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Halle

It may be that a varied history provides perspective that lends itself well to such studies. Emeria Halle became a patron of Emerisk many cycles after after opening a home for children displaced during the dark lord's reign of terror.
也许正是曲折的家史赋予了开阔的见识，格外适宜这类学问。埃梅里亚·哈勒在开办收容所、收留黑暗领主恐怖统治期间流离失所的孩童之后，又过许多轮，成为了埃梅里斯克的资助人。
